_comment: Hand-maintained entries the package graph cannot produce (packaging design, section 10). Texts are the standard licence texts; `null` licence means not yet confirmed and blocks a release build.

msvc.name: Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime
msvc.licence: Microsoft Software License Terms for Visual Studio: Distributable Code
msvc.note: Windows builds only. Unmodified app-local copies of the redistributable files named above, placed beside the inference engine's binaries, which need them; Microsoft lists these files as Distributable Code that may be redistributed with an application. They are not open-source software and are not covered by the licences in this file's appendix (owner decision, 2026-09-23).

model.name: Qwen3.5-4B, GGUF Q4_K_M quantisation published by unsloth
model.note: Downloaded by the app at set-up, never bundled. Licence as stated on the model card (https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3.5-4B-GGUF, base model Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B-Base), confirmed by the publisher of this build on 2026-09-22 (design decision 7).
